page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5i-c2g1.large is an x86_64 architecture server instance within the ecs.gn5i family, running on the KVM hypervisor. It features 2 dedicated physical cores with 2 vCPUs, providing a single thread per core configuration. The instance is equipped with 8.0 GB of system memory, yielding 4.0 GB of RAM per core.

This server includes a single NVIDIA P4 graphics processing unit with 8 GB of dedicated VRAM. It does not feature any local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met through network-attached block storage. Network connectivity is configured with a baseline bandwidth of 1 Gbps.

The hardware profile represents an entry-level GPU-accelerated configuration. By pairing a lower vCPU count and 8.0 GB of RAM with an NVIDIA P4 GPU, the instance offers a cost-efficient option for workloads that require GPU acceleration but do not demand massive host system memory or high CPU core counts. The lack of local storage and the 1 Gbps network baseline are key tradeoffs that require careful architectural planning for data-intensive tasks.

Appropriate workloads for this instance type include small-scale GPU-accelerated tasks such as low-concurrency inference, basic video transcoding, lightweight machine learning model testing, and entry-level graphics rendering.
